result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.module_annotation_enrichment()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Run enrichment testing across all detected communities at once. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L14419-L14514){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.module_annotation_enrichment( communities, attribute, correction="bonferroni", ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For each community and each distinct value of the given attribute, tests whether that community is enriched for that value, with multiple-testing correction applied across all tests. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [communities]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to community IDs (as returned by `cmty_louvain(return_dict=True)` etc.). [attribute]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Name of the categorical node attribute to test. [correction]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["bonferroni"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Multiple-testing correction method: `"bonferroni"` (default) or `"fdr"` (Benjamini-Hochberg). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping community IDs to enrichment results. Each result is a dict mapping attribute values to enrichment dicts (same structure as `subgraph_enrichment`), with an additional `"p_adjusted"` key. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#4e6cfe20 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="G1") .add_node(label="G2") .add_node(label="G3") .add_node(label="G4") .add_edge("G1", "G2") .add_edge("G3", "G4") ) pathways = {"G1": "X", "G2": "X", "G3": "Y", "G4": "Y"} graph.set_node_attrs( "pathway", {graph.get_id_from_label(g): p for g, p in pathways.items()} ) communities = graph.cmty_louvain(return_dict=True) results = graph.module_annotation_enrichment(communities, "pathway") len(results) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
